Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

Looking for something in particular? Try these FAQs. You can also search in the Instamojo Support Center or write to support@instamojo.com

What are Instamojo Premium Plans?

Instamojo premium stores have many advanced eCommerce features that are not included in the Lite Plan free online store. You can see our full list of features above to compare plans. On this #D2CTech platform, get a complete eCommerce experience – free domain, lower transaction fees, marketing tools & more.

Do I need to know coding to build a store ?

You need no coding knowledge to build an eCommerce store on Instamojo. You can get started with your own online store in just a few clicks. Pick from one of the Instamojo store templates and themes to customise your store and make it look just like you want to. Getting your eCommerce store up and running has never been easier.

Can I try Instamojo Premium Plans for free?

No. While we do not have a free trial for new users, we have a 14-day money back guarantee. That means if you purchase a premium plan & do not like our product, we will give you a 100% refund – no questions asked. However, the money-back guarantee is available only if the claim is made within 14 days of subscribing to the premium plans.

Can I downgrade my Instamojo online store plan?

If you want to downgrade your plan, you can do so within 14 days of choosing a plan. You will get a full refund if you downgrade within 14 days. Please note no refund will be available after the 14th day but we can still help downgrade your plan. For any queries with your subscription plan, please write to storesales@instamojo.com.

Can I ship my products with Instamojo?

Yes! You can ship your products with your favourite shipping partner on Instamojo. We have direct integrations with small business shipping solutions like Shiprocket, Shipway, Pickrr, Vamaship and more. You get doorstep pickup and delivery. Get orders on your Instamojo online store and ship with your choice of shipping partner.

Can I use my existing domain with Instamojo?

Absolutely! You can link your existing domain to your Instamojo online store directly from your dashboard. Please note the ability to link a domain to your store is available only on the Instamojo premium store plans. Upgrade to one of our affordable premium store plans to link your custom domain. You can also buy a domain for eCommerce website on Instamojo.

What is transactional pricing for Instamojo online store?

Every time you make a sale or collect a payment with Instamojo, we charge a transaction fee that helps us bring you these services. The charges vary depending on the type of product or service you are selling in your store.If you wish to forego the charges, you can choose Instamojo convenience fee.

How do I get my free domain ?

You get a free domain worth ₹1,000/- only if you subscribe to the Growth plan of Instamojo premium stores. Just choose your preferred domain on your Instamojo dashboard. If the value of it is under/up to ₹1,000, you get it for FREE. Domains are subject to availability.

Frequently asked questions (FAQs)

Looking for something in particular? Try these FAQs. You can also search in the Instamojo Support Center or write to support@instamojo.com

Does Instamojo support multi-currency payments?

We do not support multi-currency payments on Instamojo. If an international card is being used for a transaction, your customer will be charged in Indian rupees (INR).

International payments are available at request. Availability of international payments are subject to KYC approval. Need more information? Feel free to write to support@instamojo.com.

Is there an enterprise plan for Instamojo payments?

Enterprise plan or custom pricing for online payments is available at request. You can simply get in touch with our team to figure out the right fee on your online payments. Please write to support@instamojo.com to speak to an online payments expert at Instamojo.
If you’re looking for a free payment gateway option, feel free to try Instamojo convenience fee feature. It is well explained above.

When do I get my payouts?

Instamojo settles all transactions on a transaction + 3 days basis. Payouts usually take 3 days because we settle money through our own nodal account to hundreds of merchants every day. If you’re interested in understanding how online payment gateways work, check out this simple guide .
However, we also offer faster payout options like Instant Payout, Same Day payout, and Next Day payout. These options are available at a nominal extra fee. Faster payout options are subject to KYC approval.

How much GST does Instamojo charge?

We charge 18% GST per transaction. Whenever you accept a payment, we calculate a fee on the transaction. Once the fee is calculated, we proceed to calculate any applicable taxes (GST) on the fees.
Here is an elaboration of the GST calculation for your Instamojo transactions. Still unsure about GST calculation? Write to support@instamojo.com for more information.
